title: The Slow Promise
author: Gideon Underhill
blurb: Ines Pemberton, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
